additional_info.subject: 0429719 - ID0429719-DC/Si-D/GR-[Y2/S4 313650404001]Charge Without Success CRM:00314000184
additional_info.body:
Good morning Olympia,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0429719
, apologies for the late answer.
The ticket was opened for issues on charger
Hno3BF
for a client to authenticate and start the charging with a BMW on 05.06.2025.
After analyzing the logs, in my eyes the issue is due to an incorrect authentication behavior from the client.
The first attempt in on DC2 at 2025-06-05T16:44:10 (19:44 Greek time). DC2 is plugged in, but no authentication happens, no RFID is scanned or no RemoteStartTransaction is received.
The session fails after 1 minute without authentication, which is the timeout from EcoG to authenticate from the moment of plug-in. The error message from ecoG 38 "V2G - message processing (e.g invalid param, wrong internal state" is just a consequence of this behavior.
The same behavior happens at the subsequent timestamps:
2025-06-05T16:48:18
2025-06-05T16:49:45
2025-06-05T16:52:02
No authentication is done.
At 2025-06-05T16:54:43 and at 2025-06-05T16:57:27 the customer tried with the RemoteStartTransaction, but also here the procedure was incorrectly done.
To have a successful RemoteStartTransaction, this one has to be received before plugging in the vehicle. In both cases, the RemoteStartTransaction was received with the vehicle plugged in, then the vehicle was plugged out and plugged in again. The session failed then, because it would have required a new RemoteStartTransaction before plugging in for the second time.
After these two attempts, a reboot was launched.
After the reboot, a last attempt was launched, but failed again at 2025-06-05T17:15:23 as no authentication was done.
From charger side, there is a Hotfix available for EcoG v1.4.11, which increases the timeout of the EcoG to authenticate from plug-in up to 5 minutes. This Hotfix might bring some benefits to the clients, who have more time to authenticate.
However, this client tried 4 times to plug-in without authenticating by RFID within 1 minute each time.
Please let me know if you would like to install this Hotfix, otherwise I will close this ticket, as the issue was on the incorrect authorization process from the client.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.body:
Hello Fosco and thank you for reaching out.
From CPO side, there was wrong matching between QR code and plugs (by scanning QR code on the right, left plug was prepared).
Now this issue is fixed, and I think we don’t have any failed attempts – can you please confirm ?
(the only failed attempts are due to wrong authentication via RFID or other invalid cards).
Can you please confirm the proper operation of this charger within the last few weeks ?
If the mentioned hotfix is suggested to be installed, I totally agree to send it.
Please let me know if we need any information or clarification from CPO or owner.
Otherwise, we can close this ticket.
Have a nice afternoon.
Olympia
